description: Triggers for an independent multi-axis review of a pull request against its spec and plan, verify-then-verdict triage, receiving review findings, scoped re-review and Test sign-off preparation

queries.query: Review PR #57 against its spec and plan before the human reviewer looks at it
Run the spec-compliance, correctness, design and security lenses on this branch diff and give me GO or NO-GO
The reviewer left eight findings on my PR — help me work through them properly without just agreeing to everything
Re-review only the fixes since commit e55a417 and tell me whether F-1 and F-2 are resolved
Prepare the review guide and the questions for the engineer who will give Test sign-off on this pull request
Check whether this diff quietly weakened tests, skipped specs or lowered the coverage threshold
Two reviewers flagged the same line in export.ts — merge the findings and decide which ones are real before rating them
Do an independent code review of this feature branch in fresh contexts; I wrote the code so I can't review it myself
This is the third review round and there's still a Critical open — what happens now?
Write acceptance tests from the spec for AC-1 to AC-6 before the developer finishes
Run the DoD commands and fill the Verification table with fingerprints for this PR
Build a STRIDE threat model for the new payments endpoint before we write the spec
This test fails intermittently on CI, find the root cause
Write the spec with acceptance criteria for the CSV export
Implement task T3 test-first from the approved plan
Write the release notes and decide whether to merge or keep the branch
Explain what this regex in utils.ts does
Run only security lens L3 with gitleaks and npm audit on this diff
